name: Move, Move, Melon!!
description:
About This Game

Meet Melon — a very determined hamster balanced atop her trusty ball, rolling headfirst into the most colorful, chaotic worlds you've ever seen. Help Melon achieve the greatest feat in the history of the universe:

Roll the biggest scoop of ice cream the world has ever seen!

From sun-soaked sandy beaches to glittering underground crystal caverns, fiery volcanic islands to mysterious midnight landscapes, Melon's got ground to cover and treats to collect, and nothing is going to stop her. Even if her owner Shank keeps trying to put her down…

Race through hand-crafted levels packed with obstacles, enemies, and sweet collectibles scattered across every path.

Dodge charging foes, weave between towering crystal formations, and navigate crumbling terrain as the world rushes past at full speed.

After each run, flip open Melon's scrapbook and track your treats collected, your time, and your score.

Climb the ranks, beat your personal best, and work toward unlocking everything this sugary little world has to offer!

A Short-and-Sweet Adventure

Move, Move, Melon!! is designed to be completed in a single sitting, with most players finishing the story in about 20–25 minutes.

About the Developers

Move, Move, Melon!! was created by a team of students through USC Games' Advanced Games Project, a year-long capstone program focused on developing and releasing original games.
short_desc: You’re Melon, a tiny hamster with a huge goal. Collect mix-ins, roll fast, and build momentum to churn the biggest ice cream scoop ever in this whimsical, on-rails runner.
